spans.s:
Smoke.
2

A saint.
E.
धूम to agitate, Uṇādi affix क्.

m. (-नः)
1 KETU, the personified descending node.
2 Fire or its deity.
E.
धूम smoke, and केतन a symbol.

m. (-तुः)
1 A comet or falling-star.
2

Fire.
3

The personified descending node.
E.
धूम smoke, and केतु a mark or symbol.

m. (-जः)
Fire.
E.
धूम smoke, and ध्वज a sign or symbol.

f. (-भा)
A division of hell, the hell of smoke.
E.
धूम, and प्रभा what shines.

f. (-षी)
Fog, mist.
E.
धूम smoke, महिषी a buffalo.

m. (-निः)
A cloud.
E.
धूम smoke, and योनि womb; what is engendered from smoke or vapour.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Of a purple colour.
m. (-लः)
Purple, a colour compounded of black and red.
E.
धूम smoke, and ल what is, being of the hue of smoke.

f. (-तिः)
A cloud or quantity of smoke.
E.
धूम, and संहति collection.

f. (-सी)
A cake of pulse steeped in water, and dried in the sun.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Of the form or appearance of smoke.
E.
धूम, and आकार form.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Of a purple colour.
m. (-भः)
Purple.
E.
धूम smoke, and आभ resembling; of a smoky hue.

f. (-लिः)
A wreath or cloud of smoke.
E.
धूम, and आवलि a line.

f. (-का)
Fog, vapour.
E.
धूम smoke, and कन् affix of resemblance.

f. (-र्णा)
The wife of YAMA.
E.
धूम smoke, and ऊर्ण wool; of a smoky hue, and woolly-headed, a Caffree Proserpine.

m. (-तिः)
YAMA, the ruler of the dead.
E.
धूमोर्णा as above, and पति husband.

f. (-म्या)
A quantity of smoke.
E.
धूम with य affix, implying aggregation.

m. (-टः)
The fork-tailed shrike. धूम्या much smoke, and अट who goes.

mfn. (-म्रः-म्रा-म्रं)
Of a purple or smoky colour.
m. (-म्रः)
Purple; the colour; a compound of red and black.
n. (-म्रं)
Sin, vice, wickedness.
E.
धूम smoke, रा to get, affix क, deriv. irr.

m. (-कः)
A camel.
E.
धूम्र smoky, कन् affix; of a smoky or tawny hue.

m. (-नः)
A pigeon.
E.
धूम्र dark, लोचन the eye.

mfn. (-रुक्)
Of a purple colour.
E.
धूम्र, and रुच् to shine, affix क्विप्.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
Of a smoky hue.
m. (-र्णः)
Incense.
f. (-र्णा)
Flame, or one of the seven tongues of AGNI or fire.
E.
धूम्र smoky or purplish, and वर्णं colour.

m. (-क्षिः)
A pearl of a bad colour.
E.
धूम्र smoky, अक्षि an eye.

m. (-टः)
The fork-tailed shrike.
E.
धूम्र smoky, and अट who goes.

m. (-भः)
Air, wind.
E.
धूम्र smoky, आभ who shines.

f. (-का)
The Sisu tree.
E.
कन् added to धूम्र, fem. form.
